# Output token index

<!-- GENERATED by tools/gen_output_index.py - do not edit by hand -->

Every output token PCGen implements, read from the classes that declare
them. PCGen `6.09.08.RC1`, commit [`d262f8b4`](https://github.com/PCGen/pcgen/tree/d262f8b44952860ff857132035fb32d8d11361fa).

**154 tokens**, of which 49 are deprecated.

!!! warning "These are not LST tags"
    An LST tag is read from a data file. An output token is written in a
    character sheet template and reads a value back out of a finished
    character. Different system, different classes. For LST tags see the
    [tag index](../lst/reference/tag-index.md).

## What this index does not carry

Argument syntax. A marker such as `|STAT.0.MOD|` is one token name and two
arguments, and the arguments exist only inside the token's own parsing code.
There is no sub-token registry to read, so nothing can enumerate them.

Use this index to answer *does this token exist, and where is it
implemented*. Read the class for what it accepts. See
[output and saving](../internals/output-and-saving.md).

## Tokens

`core` tokens are registered directly by the export handler. `plugin`
tokens arrive through the plugin jars, the same way LST tags do.

## Deprecated

These sit in a `deprecated` package. Nothing in the source names a
replacement, and no deprecation message is logged, so the package is the
only signal. Treat them as present but not to be used in new sheets.

## FreeMarker model keys

A FreeMarker sheet does not use the tokens above directly. It reads a data
model, and these are its top-level keys, collected from where each is
registered.

| Key | Registered in |
|---|---|
| `abilities` | `code/src/java/pcgen/cdom/facet/GrantedAbilityFacet.java` |
| `ageset` | `code/src/java/pcgen/cdom/facet/analysis/AgeSetFacet.java` |
| `alignment` | `code/src/java/pcgen/cdom/facet/FacetInitialization.java` |
| `checks` | `code/src/java/pcgen/cdom/facet/model/CheckFacet.java` |
| `classes` | `code/src/java/pcgen/cdom/facet/model/ClassFacet.java` |
| `companionmods` | `code/src/java/pcgen/cdom/facet/model/CompanionModFacet.java` |
